interface.shortDescription: BDD spec-driven delivery workflow for GitHub issue work.
interface.longDescription: NMG SDLC provides a structured manual software delivery workflow: coordinate epics through executable child issues, write BDD specifications, implement and verify scoped work, and deliver pull requests through review, exact-head merge, issue closure, and eligible epic reconciliation.
defaultPrompt: Onboard this project for spec-driven delivery.
